name: Question 4
problem:
$$
C=[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 & -5 & -7 \\ -4 & -7 & 3 & 9 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 & 11 \\ 0 & -2 & -2 & -1\end{aligned}]
$$

 

If $C=LU$ is the LU decomposition of the matrix $C$ given above, what is the value of ${l}_{32}\cdot {u}_{33}?$
worked_solution:
Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix $C$ to row echelon form to obtain the matrix $U,$ as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix $L.$

$$
\begin{aligned}C & =[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 & -5 & -7 \\ -4 & -7 & 3 & 9 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 & 11 \\ 0 & -2 & -2 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+1{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 & -5 & -7 \\ -1 & -2 & -2 & 2 \\ 0 & -4 & -8 & 11 \\ 0 & -2 & -2 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 & -5 & -7 \\ -1 & -2 & -2 & 2 \\ 0 & \,2\, & -4 & 7 \\ 0 & -2 & -2 & -1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{4} & :={R}_{4}+(-1){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 & -5 & -7 \\ -1 & -2 & -2 & 2 \\ 0 & \,2\, & -4 & 7 \\ 0 & \,1\, & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
L=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 1\end{aligned}],\,U=[\begin{aligned}4 & 5 & -5 & -7 \\ 0 & -2 & -2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & -4 & 7 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

Finally, since ${l}_{32}=2$ and ${u}_{33}=-4,$ we get

$$
{l}_{32}\cdot {u}_{33}=2\cdot (-4)=-8.
$$

EXPLANATION

Let's apply our standard LU factorization algorithm.

We reduce the matrix C to row echelon form to obtain the matrix U, as usual. However, instead of writing zeros below the main diagonal, we will instead write down the entries of the matrix L.

C=[45−5−7−4−7390−4−8110−2−2−1]R2:=R2+1R1∼[45−5−7−1−2−220−4−8110−2−2−1]R3:=R3+(−2)R2∼[45−5−7−1−2−2202−470−2−2−1]R4:=R4+(−1)R2∼[45−5−7−1−2−2202−47010−3].

Therefore, we obtain L=[1000−110002100101],U=[45−5−70−2−2200−47000−3].

Finally, since l32=2 and u33=−4, we get

l32⋅u33=2⋅(−4)=−8.
